info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Creditcard Applications Creditchecks-v3-spec
info.description: This API endpoint allows users to retrieve the status of credit check requests associated with credit card applications. It provides valuable insights into the evaluation process of potential applicants, making it essential for financial institutions and credit assessment teams. Users can access detailed information about various credit checks tied to specific applications, helping them make informed decisions. Typical consumers of this API include financial analysts, application processors, and risk management teams who rely on accurate credit assessment data.

get.summary: Retrieve Credit Check Information for Applications
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch detailed credit check information associated with applications. Utilize this to assess the creditworthiness of applicants based on the latest credit data.
